thread:
emma-cs: FYI Harvest renewal in 2 weeks. Their avg token cost is ~1.18x forecast and interactive p95 is up 40% vs baseline. They asked for low-risk perf moves we can run without changing behavior.

jake-eng: Quick options: routing low-priority requests to a dedicated small-GPU pool, enable KV/prefix caching for repeated templates, and a conservative quant canary (q4) for short chats.

priya-ml: Data note: Harvest traffic is ~85% <128 tokens and only ~6% are codegen. On that distribution q4_8bit reduced p95 by ~25% on our sandbox. Suggest canary only for non-code routes.

nate-ops: Operational guardrails: 1) 24h 5% -> 24h 25% -> 48h 75% rollout, 2) automatic rollback on quality-delta <= -0.02 or error-rate x3. Will set TTL for quick revert.

emma-cs: Customer prefers explicit opt-in for anything that could change outputs. Can we present a one-pager and rollback criteria?

jake-eng: I'll draft the short plan: canary config + exclude tag `codegen` + fallback rule. Snippet:
```
canary_percent: [5,25,75]
exclude_tags: ["codegen"]
fallback: on_quality_drop->control
```
Also add dashboard widget for cost delta and per-route quality diffs.

priya-ml: Recommend also running a tiny tokenization normalization for their IDs before canary to avoid q4 artifacts. Low-risk and easy to A/B.

emma-cs: I'll schedule a 20m call and capture their sign-off in Gainsight. Update renewal board to "monitoring" while canary runs.

tracker-bot: Created ticket CS-8009 to track Harvest perf canary. Owners: priya-ml, jake-eng, emma-cs. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-8009

nate-ops: Will provision a dedicated small pool for rerank/batch jobs overnight to reduce p95 during business hours.

emma-cs: Thanks all, will follow up after the 5% canary completes and attach diffs to the renewal thread. :pray:
